_comment: WCTA Cyber games data. Edit THIS FILE to add/remove games or categories - no code changes needed. Each game needs: category, name, url, description. Categories repeat freely; the page groups them automatically, assigns each a colour, and builds the filter buttons, boot-log mount lines, headings, counts and search index from whatever it finds here. Category display order follows the order games first appear below. NOTE: JSON does not allow a trailing comma after the last item in the tools array - the last entry must end with } and no comma. (The array is still called 'tools' so the page code matches apps.wctacyber.org.)
